hsc2hs.reason: Use the identically versioned hsc2hs bundled with the selected GHC. Verify its resolved Cabal program path and version against that compiler's actual derivation graph.

dhall.reason: Enable HTTPS imports in shipped binaries, including cache misses. The Cabal compatibility solve disables TLS; both systems retain the same upstream source revision. The hook asserts that this source admits the selected TLS cohort.

dhall-json.reason: Mirror the three narrowly verified Cabal compatibility exceptions for aeson, bytestring and text while preserving released Haskell source and every other bound.

monad-control.reason: Mirror the verified Cabal transformers-compat 0.8 exception while preserving released Haskell source and every other bound.
